invariants.description: Control flow nesting depth must not exceed 4 levels; functions must not exceed 80 lines.
No flat retries or blind sleep synchronization; exponential backoff with full jitter required.
Chained type assertions (as unknown as T) and ungrounded casts without // SAFETY: are forbidden.
Conditional empty object spreads ...(c ? { x } : {}) are forbidden; declare explicit optionals.
Quadratic accumulator object copying inside .reduce() is forbidden; mutate or use Object.fromEntries.
Comment-to-Code Ratio must remain <= 0.35; syntax play-by-play comments are forbidden.
Cumulative Layout Shift must equal 0.000; pre-reserve aspect ratios and scrollbar-gutter: stable.
Normal text must satisfy WCAG 2.2 AA contrast >= 4.5:1; large text >= 3.0:1.
Test doubles, mock databases, and silent SQLite dummy fallbacks are forbidden on production paths.
Tautological assertions, circular mock verifications, and swallowed test assertions are forbidden.
Delete code and processes before optimizing; track add-back rate between 10% and 25%.
Agent state notes must remain <= 1500 tokens with discrete NEXT_SINGLE_ACTION passing the Shower Test.
State mutating endpoints must require Idempotency-Key header backed by atomic distributed store.
Metric dimensions must remain bounded: dynamic IDs in label keys are strictly prohibited.
